answer: Each identity gets an interleaved timetable: 14 live micro-tasks and rest slots, dealt from a public seed, a sonnet of 14 lines no two alike, sealed in a vault of hash commitments no operator can preview or swap. Each live slot opens for 90 seconds and demands a fresh answer to a random prompt; miss it and the identity freezes, its 10-credit bond burns. One operator running 100 clones cannot serve 100 conflicting timetables: each clone missing half its slots costs 7,000 credits per epoch (100 × 7 × 10). A clone army moves like a glacier, too slow and rigid to keep 100 rhythms at once.
